name: BURSA
recent: Bursa Malaysia 近期公告以 EPF 的股东权益变动申报为主，同时出现公司秘书与主要高管的人事变动。最新一季（截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日）营收同比增长 25.5%，净利同比增长 23.0%。新闻方面，市场报道集中在马股大盘走低与科技股卖压。
notable: EPF 在 9 月至 11 月期间多次申报作为大股东的权益变动。
公司于 10 月 28 日发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日的季度业绩。
公司于 10 月及 11 月先后更换公司秘书，并出现主要高管变动。
risks: EPF 作为大股东在短期内频繁申报权益变动。
公司出现公司秘书及主要高管人事变动。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度，营收为 MYR 209.182 million，同比增长 25.5%，环比增长 2.1%；净利为 MYR 70.206 million，同比增长 23.0%，环比下降 2.2%；净利率为 33.6%，低于上一季度的 35.0%。

recent_en: Bursa Malaysia's recent announcements were mainly EPF substantial shareholder changes, alongside company secretary and principal officer changes. The latest quarter ended 30 Sep 2026 saw revenue up 25.5% YoY and net profit up 23.0% YoY. News coverage focused on the broader Malaysian market closing lower and tech stock selling pressure.
notable_en: EPF filed multiple substantial shareholder changes between September and November.
The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 Sep 2026 on 28 October.
The company changed company secretaries in October and November, and there was a change in principal officer.
risks_en: EPF, a substantial shareholder, filed frequent changes in its interests over a short period.
There were changes in company secretary and principal officer.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 Sep 2026, revenue was MYR 209.182 million, up 25.5% YoY and 2.1% QoQ; net profit was MYR 70.206 million, up 23.0% YoY but down 2.2% QoQ; net margin was 33.6%, lower than 35.0% in the previous quarter.
